disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. Do not attribute a named SKU to this parser fallback.

joining.summary: Joining fees in the MITC include ₹500 for Coral and nil for Platinum Chip and Amazon Pay. Do not apply one SKU's fee to this fallback.

annual.summary: Annual fees are product-specific. Coral is ₹500. Platinum Chip and Amazon Pay are nil.

annual_waiver.summary: Waiver rules are product-specific. Coral waives the next year after more than ₹1.5 lakh spend.

forex.summary: Forex markup is often 3.5 percent. Amazon Pay is 1.99 percent.

fuel_surcharge.summary: Fuel surcharge waivers are product-specific. Several ICICI cards waive 1 percent at HPCL on ₹400 to ₹4,000.

base_earn.summary: Earn is product-specific. Coral and Platinum Chip use reward points. Amazon Pay credits Amazon Pay balance.

redemption.summary: Redemption is through the ICICI catalogue or a partner wallet depending on the SKU.

expiry.summary: Point expiry is product-specific. Amazon Pay marketing says earnings never expire.

summary.summary: Domestic lounge on several ICICI cards is spend-gated at ₹75,000 in the previous calendar quarter. Exceptions and Platinum Chip marketing differ. Do not assume lounge for an unspecified ICICI card. Priority Pass is not a fourth venue type; it is only a delivery mechanism when a named SKU uses it.

railway.summary: Railway lounge entitlements are product-specific. Coral advertises railway lounge. Platinum Chip does not.

concierge.summary: Concierge is product-specific. Coral RuPay lists a 24x7 concierge.

accident.summary: Accident cover is product-specific. Coral RuPay lists ₹2 lakh personal accident cover.
